strings.text: Two high school counselors, one for public and independent schools and one for boarding — a structure the school added in 2023-24.
strings.t: Due consulenti per l’ammissione alle scuole superiori, una per le scuole pubbliche e indipendenti e una per i collegi — una struttura che la scuola ha introdotto nel 2023-24.

strings.text: Trinity frames the K–8 model as choosing a high school at the end of 8th grade rather than at the start of Kindergarten.
strings.t: Trinity presenta il modello K–8 come la scelta di una scuola superiore alla fine della classe 8ª anziché all’inizio del Kindergarten.

strings.text: high school counsellors, by published scope
strings.t: consulenti per l’ammissione alle superiori, per ambito pubblicato

strings.text: years on one campus before the search begins
strings.t: anni su un unico campus prima che inizi la ricerca

strings.text: Throughout Middle School — knowing the schools
strings.t: Per tutta la Middle School — conoscere le scuole

strings.text: The counsellor for public and independent placement visits area schools and, in her words, gets “a feel for who might benefit from knowing this school,” then points families toward fits based on what they want: “Do they want big class sizes? Are sports important? Extracurricular?”
strings.t: La consulente per il collocamento nelle scuole pubbliche e indipendenti visita le scuole della zona e, con le sue parole, si fa “a feel for who might benefit from knowing this school,” per poi indirizzare le famiglie verso le soluzioni adatte in base a ciò che desiderano: “Do they want big class sizes? Are sports important? Extracurricular?”

strings.text: Middle School — the boarding track, if a family wants it
strings.t: Middle School — il percorso del collegio, se una famiglia lo desidera

strings.text: Boarding placement is handled separately and by a different person. It is not a marginal path here: 12% of all graduates since 2004 went to boarding schools, and the destination list includes Deerfield, Lawrenceville, Mercersburg, Woodberry Forest, St. Paul’s and The Taft School.
strings.t: Il collocamento nei collegi è gestito separatamente e da un’altra persona. Non è una strada marginale qui: il 12% di tutti i diplomati dal 2004 è andato in collegi, e l’elenco delle destinazioni comprende Deerfield, Lawrenceville, Mercersburg, Woodberry Forest, St. Paul’s e The Taft School.

strings.text: The school’s stated case is that nine years of one faculty knowing a child produces a better-informed choice: parents “feel more confident about finding the high school that’s best suited for their child at the end of 8th Grade rather than at the beginning of Kindergarten.”
strings.t: La tesi dichiarata della scuola è che nove anni in cui un unico corpo docente conosce un bambino producano una scelta più informata: i genitori “feel more confident about finding the high school that’s best suited for their child at the end of 8th Grade rather than at the beginning of Kindergarten.”

strings.text: Ninety-five named high schools across 23 graduating classes — and ten of them have their own dossier here.
strings.t: Novantacinque scuole superiori nominate in 23 classi di diplomati — e dieci di esse hanno un proprio dossier qui.

strings.text: This is the school’s own cumulative list for the Classes of 2004–2026, grouped by what each destination actually is. It is a list of names only: the school publishes no per-school counts and no per-year attribution, so no destination should be read as “N students went there”.
strings.t: Questo è l’elenco cumulativo della scuola stessa per le classi dal 2004 al 2026, raggruppato in base a ciò che ciascuna destinazione è effettivamente. È un elenco di soli nomi: la scuola non pubblica né conteggi per scuola né attribuzioni per anno, quindi nessuna destinazione va letta come “N studenti ci sono andati”.

strings.text: What standardized test do your 8th graders sit for high school admission, and when? The school publishes nothing on this.
strings.t: Quale test standardizzato sostengono i vostri studenti di classe 8ª per l’ammissione alle superiori, e quando? La scuola non pubblica nulla al riguardo.

strings.text: What share of last year’s class got into their first-choice high school? No figure is published, so ask for it directly.
strings.t: Quale quota della classe dello scorso anno è stata ammessa alla scuola superiore di prima scelta? Non è pubblicato alcun dato, quindi conviene chiederlo direttamente.

strings.text: What does the placement calendar look like — when does the search start, and what happens each term?
strings.t: Com’è fatto il calendario del collocamento — quando inizia la ricerca, e che cosa succede in ciascun trimestre?

strings.text: The counsellor roles began in 2023-24. How has the process changed since, and who holds each role now?
strings.t: I ruoli di consulente sono nati nel 2023-24. Come è cambiato il processo da allora, e chi ricopre oggi ciascun ruolo?

strings.text: Do graduates win merit scholarships at their high schools? No counts or dollars are published anywhere.
strings.t: I diplomati ottengono borse di studio al merito nelle loro scuole superiori? Non sono pubblicati da nessuna parte né conteggi né importi.

strings.text: The 2004–2026 destination list marks 41 of 99 schools with an asterisk and gives no legend — what does it mean?
strings.t: L’elenco delle destinazioni 2004–2026 contrassegna con un asterisco 41 scuole su 99 e non fornisce alcuna legenda — che cosa significa?

strings.text: 97% of the Class of 2026 were accepted into one or both of their top two high school choices — and Charlotte Prep has published a rate like it for every class since 2023.
strings.t: Il 97% della classe del 2026 è stato ammesso in una o in entrambe le prime due scuole superiori scelte — e Charlotte Prep ha pubblicato un tasso analogo per ogni classe dal 2023.

strings.text: Fifteen members of the Class of 2026 were accepted to every school they applied to, the school says.
strings.t: Quindici membri della classe del 2026 sono stati ammessi in tutte le scuole a cui avevano fatto domanda, secondo la scuola.

strings.text: A dedicated placement team, a twelve-step path that starts before 8th grade, and a fall fair that brings over 40 high schools to campus to recruit.
strings.t: Un team dedicato al collocamento, un percorso in dodici tappe che inizia prima della classe 8ª e una fiera autunnale che porta oltre 40 scuole superiori nel campus a reclutare.

strings.text: The application is parent-driven, but the school manages the rest: "Our team manages all other aspects of the process to minimize stress and provide all necessary materials."
strings.t: La domanda è gestita dai genitori, ma del resto si occupa la scuola: "Our team manages all other aspects of the process to minimize stress and provide all necessary materials."

to the High School Fair and Boarding School Fair
strings.t: alla High School Fair e alla Boarding School Fair

strings.text: the one admissions test the school names
strings.t: l’unico test di ammissione che la scuola nomina

strings.text: Spring of 7th grade — the Parent Coffee
strings.t: Primavera della classe 7ª — il Parent Coffee

strings.text: "Each spring, rising 8th-grade parents attend a Parent Coffee to learn about the admissions process, events, deadlines, and other tips and information to prepare for the year ahead."
strings.t: "Each spring, rising 8th-grade parents attend a Parent Coffee to learn about the admissions process, events, deadlines, and other tips and information to prepare for the year ahead."

strings.text: Students sit the Independent School Entrance Exam for practice in 7th grade, then for high school placement in 8th, and the school provides ISEE test preparation in between: "Students learn test-taking strategies and prepare for admissions testing to gain comfort and fine tune skills."
strings.t: Gli studenti sostengono l’Independent School Entrance Exam per esercitarsi in classe 7ª, poi per il collocamento alle superiori in classe 8ª, e nel frattempo la scuola offre la preparazione al test ISEE: "Students learn test-taking strategies and prepare for admissions testing to gain comfort and fine tune skills."

strings.text: September of 8th grade — the High School Fair
strings.t: Settembre della classe 8ª — la High School Fair

strings.text: "In September, administrators from over 40 schools are invited to Charlotte Prep's High School Fair and Boarding School Fair to recruit our students." The boarding fair includes a panel discussion — one 2026 family credits it with their decision to pursue boarding school.
strings.t: "In September, administrators from over 40 schools are invited to Charlotte Prep's High School Fair and Boarding School Fair to recruit our students." La fiera dei collegi comprende una tavola rotonda — una famiglia del 2026 le attribuisce la decisione di puntare su un collegio.

strings.text: Fall of 8th grade — meetings and school visits
strings.t: Autunno della classe 8ª — colloqui e visite alle scuole

strings.text: The team meets individually with each 8th grader and separately with each student's parents "to discuss their plans, their objectives for their child, and appropriate placement opportunities." Families are encouraged to visit open houses and tours, and students make day visits to the schools on their list.
strings.t: Il team incontra individualmente ogni studente di classe 8ª e separatamente i genitori di ciascuno "to discuss their plans, their objectives for their child, and appropriate placement opportunities." Le famiglie sono incoraggiate a partecipare a open house e visite guidate, e gli studenti trascorrono giornate di visita nelle scuole della loro lista.

strings.text: "In Leadership class, students learn interview etiquette and conduct. They learn about proper dress, eye contact, handshake, and what to look for as they seek the school that fits them best." Teachers and administrators run mock interviews, and the brochure adds a practice interview with the head of school.
strings.t: "In Leadership class, students learn interview etiquette and conduct. They learn about proper dress, eye contact, handshake, and what to look for as they seek the school that fits them best." Insegnanti e amministratori conducono colloqui simulati, e la brochure aggiunge un colloquio di prova con il capo d’istituto.

strings.text: Winter of 8th grade — applications and advocacy
strings.t: Inverno della classe 8ª — domande e sostegno ai candidati

strings.text: "Charlotte Prep electronically delivers our students' complete transcripts and teacher recommendation packets to the schools prior to deadlines." The team then meets with each high school "for in-depth conversations about our student applicants and to provide further insight to ensure each student is well known."
strings.t: "Charlotte Prep electronically delivers our students' complete transcripts and teacher recommendation packets to the schools prior to deadlines." Il team poi incontra ciascuna scuola superiore "for in-depth conversations about our student applicants and to provide further insight to ensure each student is well known."

strings.text: More than 60 high schools across all of Charlotte Prep’s alumni — and, for each class from 2023 to 2026, exactly where its graduates are heading.
